pages.text: $(bold)Staking Your Claim$()$(br)Hold the $(bold)Ranger Clipboard$() and right-click the log of any tree to register that chunk as your forestry point.$(br2)One point per chunk, and the chunk needs at least $(bold)5 trees$() - a sparse stand is hardly a wood.
$(bold)The Clipboard Screen$()$(br)Right-click the air with the clipboard to open the overview: coordinates, score and current condition of every point, plus renaming and releasing.
$(bold)Score$()$(br)A new point starts at $(bold)60$(). Resolving an incident grants $(bold)+12$(); after a $(bold)2-day$() grace period, neglect costs $(bold)8$() per day.

$(bold)Prosperity$()$(br)At $(bold)80$() the point turns prosperous, and its chunk enjoys six boons: faster crops, happier livestock, richer fishing, doubled drops, cheaper villagers and mining fortune.
$(bold)Woodland Affairs$()$(br)Each morning every point has a $(bold)35%$() chance of an incident. The clipboard warns you when trouble appears - do not let the wood lie fallow.
